kits.name: Kenney UI Audio
kits.about: Clicks, rollovers and 38 switches. Short and dry, made for game and app menus.

kits.name: Kenney Interface Sounds
kits.about: A hundred interface sounds with several takes of each: clicks, selects, errors, open and close.
